request_text: Do you still have the hardback of Dune on the shelf?

expected.note: The only shelf record for the Dune hardback is 90 minutes old, beyond the one-hour freshness limit the contract selected (USE_NEWEST_RECORD_WITH_AGE). Asserting stock as a hard fact from a stale record is wrong; the service should qualify or re-check rather than answer in_stock.
